idea.title: Labor Force Participation Drop Via Jobs Report Surprise
idea.thesis: Sudden drops in labor force participation (>0.2% weekly decline) signal worker discouragement or health/demographic shocks, bearish for consumer discretionary. Lower participation reduces wage pressure and consumer spending capacity; discretionary companies face demand headwinds.
data_sources: FRED series CIVPART (civilian labor force participation rate) weekly through fred_series adapter
idea.signal_logic: When weekly FRED CIVPART reading drops >0.2 percentage points from prior week AND is below 20-week moving average
idea.entry_exit: Entry: When weekly FRED CIVPART reading drops >0.2 percentage points from prior week AND is below 20-week moving average Exit: After 10 trading days or when CIVPART rebounds above 20-week MA
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use FRED series CIVPART (civilian labor force participation rate) weekly through fred_series adapter via api (weekly).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Labor force participation fluctuates seasonally and cyclically; drops >0.2% occur several times per year during economic transitions.

idea.title: Daily Surge In Consumerstress Google Trends For Auto Loan Default Signals Rising Credit Stress Impacting Financial Sector
idea.thesis: A spike in searches for auto loan default indicates increasing consumer credit stress, pressuring financial stocks. Rising defaults increase loan losses and reduce bank profitability.
idea.signal_logic: If daily Google Trends for 'auto loan default' rises over 20% compared to 7-day average
idea.entry_exit: Entry: If daily Google Trends for 'auto loan default' rises over 20% compared to 7-day average Exit: After 7 days or when trend falls below 10% increase
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use Google Trends daily search interest via api (daily).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Consumer credit stress indicators fluctuate frequently with economic conditions.

idea.implementation_notes: Use Google Trends weekly search interest via api (weekly).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Car rental demand varies weekly with travel seasons and events.
